answer: Problem: cheap clones flood attestation. Mechanism: each new identity posts a 0.8 POA onyx bond locked 72h, then must pass a falcon challenge—solve a 12-bit PoW tied to its address within 90s before any grade seat opens. Cost: ~0.8 POA plus ~2s CPU per attempt. Verification: peers recompute sha256(addr|nonce) and check bond UTXO height. Failure: missed window or reuse burns 40% of the bond to the zephyr burn sink; survivors keep the rest after 72h.
